processes.title: Monthly Training Calendar Process
processes.subtitle: From collecting trainer schedules to publishing the finalized calendar.

steps.label: Inform Stakeholders to propose training calendar for the next month
steps.task: Intern reaches out to TPM, EDL Leader and other departments (QA, HSE, Beverage, Cafe, etc.) asking them to propose their training / activity schedule for the upcoming month.
steps.note: Priority order for finalizing the schedule: Mandatory Training > Training run by L&D > QA Training > Training from other departments.

steps.label: Discuss & Inform training calendar
steps.task: In response to the Intern's outreach, other departments (QA, HSE, Beverage, Cafe, etc.) share the extra context needed to complete the calendar.

steps.label: Inform e-learning launching
steps.task: In response to the Intern's outreach, the EDL team shares information on any upcoming e-learning launch so it can be folded into the monthly calendar.

steps.label: Input training calendar to OSKB
steps.task: In response to the Intern's outreach, TPM & Trainers place the finalized class schedule directly on OSKB.

steps.label: Collect training calendar from trainers
steps.task:
Confirming (1.1.2):
- Food Safety Management class: QA finalizes the schedule based on L&D's suggestion in the group chat.
- Classes run by L&D: TPM & Trainers fill in OSKB.
- Classes run by other departments: confirmed via discussion.
- E-learning info (if any): EDL team announces the finalized schedule.

Confirmation message (1.1.3): send a message finalizing the schedule to the other L&D stakeholders.
steps.note: Consolidates the responses from TPM, EDL Leader and other departments above.

steps.label: Input calendar to L&D Google Calendar
steps.task: Input all finalized schedules into the L&D account's Google Calendar by filling in the automatic calendar-input file.
steps.note: Do not delete rows — only fill in the blue header columns in the '1.1 ILT Details' sheet. Do not adjust the other sheets.

steps.label: Design calendar on Canva
steps.task: Pick a theme and finish the calendar design in Canva.
steps.note: Choose a theme and style with global appeal — not Vietnam-only.

steps.label: Draft communication content (for email & group chat)
steps.task: Check with the relevant L&D team members on what each course needs to highlight, then write communication copy that fits the design theme.

files.label: File nhập nội dung truyền thông

steps.note: Keep the tone youthful and concise — not overly formal — while still covering every important point.

steps.label: Review
steps.task: Send the design + copy to the L&D Staff group so TPM & Trainers can review and give feedback.
steps.note: Reviewers comment directly in the docs file and in Canva.

steps.label: Review
steps.task: Send the design to the L&D | EDL group for the EDL team to review and give feedback.
steps.note: Reviewers comment directly in the docs file and in Canva.

steps.label: Review
steps.task: Send to the L&D Manager for final review before communication goes out.
steps.note: Reviewers comment directly in the docs file and in Canva.

steps.label: Send communication via email & group chat
steps.task: Send the finalized calendar by email using the 'Monthly Calendar' template, and post it to the group chats.
steps.timeline: 27th – 31st of each month · latest by the 1st of the following month
steps.note: If any training is happening abroad, also notify the relevant overseas AM/SRM/RM/ASM.

steps.label: Update calendar on Ops site
steps.task: Update the content that was emailed onto the Ops Google Site, following the existing template.

files.label: File Nội dung calendar publish Google site
